changedBehavior: Releases move from the 1.4 feature family to 1.5: release.yml generates version 1.5.<run> and tag v1.5.<run> and prepends docs\release-notes-1.5.md to the release body. The new changelog covers every merged change after #584 through this PR. Installer lifecycle tests use feature family 1.5, so they check a higher-build 1.4 installation upgrading to 1.5 and the rejected 1.4 downgrade. Workflow-contract tests, the docs\reference.md release and installer sections, and the tools\README.md example no longer assume 1.4. CI's separate 0.0 identity is unchanged.
expectedAssertions: The release identity step yields number 1.5.<run> and tag v1.5.<run>, and the release is created with --notes-file docs\release-notes-1.5.md plus --generate-notes (PrValidation WorkflowContracts).
Installer.Lifecycle.Tests.ps1 uses FeatureFamily 1.5 and derives previous family 1.4: a higher-build 1.4 fixture upgrades to 1.5 with saved data unchanged, and the 1.4 downgrade is rejected.
docs\release-notes-1.5.md exists and links every merged application-related PR after #584 through this PR; documentation checks pass with the updated reference.md and tools\README.md.
CI's 0.0 identity and the installer script are unchanged.
